posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
I haven't touched or playtested them in quite a while.  Now that Beacon has been revealed, i'll go back and make some changes.

In playtesting, she was very offensively focused, but had much less in terms of team damage immunity and large-chunk damage prevention (like Superhuman durability and next evolution).  The card draw is quite nice, but so is a team +1 to damage.  I tried to make everything as directly comparable to Legacy as possible, but with a unique flavor and playstyle of her own.

She suffers from the same "problem" as Legacy, in that there are a lot of great options, and you have to balance personal power (IE ongoings, one-shots) with things that will benefit the team, and only one play to do it in.  Legacy has the potential to deal nearly as much damage as Ra as well, the trick is that you almost always have something to play that benefits the team more, and those back-fist strikes just taunt you....

posts.name: Humble-Knight
posts.cooked:
I would argue a free start of turn draw is 2 times as powerful than a +1 damage boost. The scholar, bunker, parse, tachyon, nightmist and even regular legacy would prefer a card draw to +1 damage.

The biggest problem I have with that card is that your entire team gets an enormous boost with no cost. Team leader tachyon has a power to do that but it is a power and if she uses team leader she loses a burst in her trash, which is a cost.

Also being able to pick who gets which damage is incredibly valuable. Giving all cold or fire damage to AZ is crazy good
